scope: Read-only local inventory of OOD task directories and other local usable candidates outside formal-v3. This audit is not a frozen executable protocol registry.
caveats: Download status files and July scan reports are stale; filesystem evidence takes precedence.
Unknown official splits or metrics are explicitly unresolved, not inferred from directory names.
Existing bio_detection.center_probe measures patch-grid occupancy, not native bounding-box average precision.

Existing frozen ridge/logistic probes can represent scalar/count regression and classification after loader/split extensions. Image restoration, 3-D centroid detection, and native bbox AP need task-specific integration, not renamed proxies.
last and 4-even feature definitions must use the framework's encoder definitions, and protocol selection must only use 1TB before freezing.

datasets.official_split: Paper describes antibody-stratified 60:20:20; supplied local lists are 167/42/53 and are not paired-FOV-disjoint.
datasets.grouping: Proposed condition-heldout: cell type plus condition A-D across both imaging dates, all markers/FOVs/channels; condition is not a replicate or specimen ID. Minimum paired-FOV key is casefold(date_celltype_condition_marker_FOV).
datasets.metric: MAE primary; RMSE and ACP within 5 percent secondary; explicit zero-count ACP semantics required.
datasets.blocker: No donor/specimen IDs. Four flagged subfield images must be excluded because annotations were quantified jointly. A single 2-train/1-validation/1-test condition split is proposed and not official. Dataset license unresolved: local readme has no license and Figshare page/API return403.

datasets.official_split: Official DAPI subset, stratified 80:20 by Jenks five count bins and objective; preserve supplied metadata set=trainval/test. Validation partition within trainval is PROPOSED_BY_US.

Requires explicit scientific dedup/annotation adjudication before sweep. Local metadata also lacks original filenames/biological specimen IDs; original specimen leakage cannot be ruled out. Do not call all-marker3023-image evaluation the official benchmark.
